title: Newly moved/created files briefly appear in the top-left-most position, before jumping to the correct location
line: New files created or dropped on the desktop now appear straight where you put them, without flashing in the top-left corner first.
explanation: When a file appears on the desktop, the Positioner puts it in the first free grid cell. The move to the click or drop position was only sent later through a queued call (deferred so it wouldn't run inside the positioner's row insertion, bug 481254), so the view could render a frame in between with the icon in the top-left cell. FolderModel now keeps these pending moves and the Positioner applies them as soon as it has finished inserting the rows, still outside the insertion; the queued call stays as a fallback.

commits.message:
Positioner: place new items before they are first shown

New and dropped files got the first free cell and were moved to the
click or drop position by a queued call, so a frame could show them in
the corner. The positioner now does those moves right after inserting.

BUG: 499976

media.caption: Master: the frame right after pressing OK in Create New > Text File, with the new file drawn in the top-left cell
With the fix: the first frame showing the new file already has it at the click position
Master, 5x slower: the file flashes in the top-left cell, then jumps to the click position
With the fix, 5x slower: the file appears directly at the click position
